start.welcome: 🛡️ Commandor Dev Pack — Email Infrastructure Platform ────────────────────────────── High-performance email alias management, subdomains, and cloud routing right inside Telegram. Generate instant aliases, claim custom identities (e.g. name-ca@commandor.my.id), receive verification codes in real time, and deploy edge-hosted sites. 📬 EMAIL ACTIONS • /inbox — Incoming mail & instant OTP extraction • /aliases — Manage & toggle active email aliases • /new — Instant disposable address • /custom <name> — Protected custom alias (with -ca) • /burner — 1-hour self-destructing address 🌐 INFRASTRUCTURE & TOOLS • /subdomains — Subdomain routing & reverse proxy • /hosting — Edge cloud hosting & server nodes • /api — REST API keys & developer documentation • /search — Search incoming messages • /web — Web Dashboard with real-time sync • /stats — Account usage & storage metrics • /language — Switch interface language • /help — Complete command guide ────────────────────────────── 👇 Choose an action below to get started:
alias.created: ✨ New Email Alias Generated! ────────────────────────────── 📬 {address} (Tap address above to copy) 🏷 Type: {type} ⏳ Status: Active (Ready for mail) ⏳ Expires: {expires} ──────────────────────────────
alias.custom_created: ✨ Custom Protected Alias Created! ────────────────────────────── 📬 {address} (Tap address above to copy) 🛡 Security: Enforced with protected -ca suffix ⏳ Expires: Permanent (Unlimited) ────────────────────────────── Ready to receive incoming emails.
alias.custom_prompt: 🎨 Create Custom Alias ────────────────────────────── Please reply with your desired alias name (e.g. finance or github). Your address will be: [name]-ca@commandor.my.id 🛡 Note: All custom aliases include -ca to protect against claiming system and administrative usernames.

help.text: 📖 Commandor Dev Pack — Command Reference ────────────────────────────── 📬 Email Management • /inbox — View received messages & OTP verification codes • /aliases — List, toggle, and manage your aliases • /new — Generate an instant disposable alias • /custom <name> — Create a custom protected alias • /burner — Create a 1-hour self-destructing address • /search <query> — Search your received emails 🌐 Infrastructure & Edge • /subdomains — Manage subdomains, reverse proxy & capture • /hosting — Deploy lightweight sites & server nodes • /api — REST API key management & tokens ⚙️ Dashboard & Account • /web — Web Dashboard with live synchronization • /login — Generate an instant 10-minute web session token • /stats — Account storage & resource metrics • /language — Switch display language • /settings — Preferences and notifications • /help — Display this reference manual ──────────────────────────────
